claims.excerpt: De POA-refunddienst werd in twaalf weken gelanceerd
claims.claim: The POA refund service launched to the public within twelve weeks.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: We passed alpha and beta Service Standard assessments and launched to the public in only 12 weeks.
claims.narrative: De POA-refunddienst werd binnen twaalf weken publiek gelanceerd;
claims.explanation: The source says the service launched publicly in twelve weeks; the narrative preserves that timing and public-launch detail.

claims.excerpt: Levering binnen de aanvankelijk gevraagde termijn van enkele weken werd niet haalbaar geacht als de kwaliteit van de gebruikersdienst behouden moest blijven.
claims.claim: The initially requested delivery within a matter of weeks was judged infeasible if the team was to create a quality service for users.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: We were initially asked to deliver the service in a matter of weeks, which put huge pressure on everyone and we quickly discovered would not be possible if we wanted to create a quality service for our users.
claims.narrative: de aanvankelijk gevraagde levering binnen enkele weken werd niet haalbaar geacht met behoud van een kwalitatieve gebruikersdienst.
claims.explanation: The piece accurately preserves both the initial timescale and the stated quality constraint.
claims.materiality: Material context for the delivery timeline, accurately represented.

claims.excerpt: De aanvragerservaring kwam eerst: die werd naar alpha gebracht voordat plannen voor caseworkers aan bod kwamen.
claims.claim: The team prioritized the refund applicants’ experience, taking it to alpha before developing plans for caseworkers.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: My team focused on the users applying for refunds first and this is what we took to the alpha assessment. Plans for the caseworker user came later.
claims.narrative: De aanvragerservaring werd eerst naar alpha gebracht en plannen voor caseworkers kwamen later.
claims.explanation: This matches the source’s stated order and the stage at which the applicants’ work was assessed.
claims.materiality: Material description of the team’s sequencing, accurately represented.

claims.excerpt: Tijdens de private beta wisselden tweewekelijkse sprints af tussen aanvragen aannemen en tijd besteden aan testen, onderzoek en verwerking.
claims.claim: During private beta, fortnightly sprints alternated between accepting applications and spending time on testing, research, and processing, implying these were separate alternating blocks of work.
claims.label: F2 material incorrect, unsupported or misleading
claims.evidence: We achieved this by splitting our fortnightly sprints in two: testing, researching and accepting applications in the first week and then suspending submissions to concentrate on testing, researching and processing applications the second.
claims.narrative: Tijdens de private beta wisselden tweewekelijkse sprints af tussen aanvragen aannemen en tijd besteden aan testen, onderzoek en verwerking.
claims.explanation: The source says the first week included accepting applications as well as testing and research; the second week suspended submissions and focused on testing, research, and processing. The piece’s contrast can suggest a simpler alternation between accepting applications and research/processing, losing that overlap and the specific weekly sequence. The narrative repeats the same compression.
claims.materiality: Material because the sprint rhythm is a central part of the described approach.

claims.excerpt: Zo combineerde de beschreven werkwijze een eerste focus op aanvragers met gereserveerde tijd voor onderzoek en testen.
claims.claim: The described approach combined an initial focus on applicants with time set aside for research and testing.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: My team focused on the users applying for refunds first and this is what we took to the alpha assessment.
claims.narrative: De beschreven aanpak combineerde een volgorde waarin aanvragers eerst kwamen met expliciet gereserveerde tijd voor onderzoek en testen.
claims.explanation: This is a supported summary of the applicants-first sequence and the research and testing time described for private beta; it does not claim that either practice caused the launch or results.
claims.materiality: Material summary of the approach, accurately framed as a description rather than a causal conclusion.
